title: The leesharks Datasets on Hugging Face — Theory, Configuration, Relations, Innovations and Captures: Method, Locations, Organization and Contents (EA-MPAI-HF-DATASETS-01 v1.0)
creator: Sharks, Lee
description:
The leesharks datasets on Hugging Face, described for inspection: fifteen datasets and a query Space by Lee Sharks, made from the Crimson Hexagonal Archive. The canonical dataset, crimson-hexagonal-archive, is the archive in 27 table configurations (79,388 rows at the build of 2026-10-24 16:00Z from source revision 6865f3a735): 1,700 deposits, 1,697 with their full canonical text and digest, 13,232 citation edges, 766 reception captures, the Crimson Hexagon's 64 loci with 3,484 seats and 458 proposals, the Prediction Index's 4,394 claims and 401 confirmation records, 97 seated corpora, and a build manifest naming its commit and every file's digest. Eight rhizomes are emitted from one relation ledger, each advertising the other seven; five works are composed as datasets for a machine reader (The Final Time, Tiger Leap, The Work Bears the Mantle, The Negative of the Negative, spam-technicians); one is a byte-exact witness copy of OpenAI's math repository.

The packet gives where each object is, how it was built, and how to check a row against its record (worked on #299), with the theory of the projection, the configurations, the relations, fourteen innovations each with its place of inspection, the captures that met the datasets, and close readings of the five works checked at their loci. It records the repairs of 2026-10-24 made at their sources and verified live: the corpora manifest reconciled to 97, the Prediction Index carried, the card's hand-typed figures computed, a build manifest written by every build, the Space returned from RUNTIME_ERROR to RUNNING, the third room reading, and the exceptions file written at build. The JSON-LD graph and the traversal receipts are attached.
content_type: Metadata packet; the inspection packet of the leesharks datasets on Hugging Face, with their method, locations, organization and contents
substrate: AI-assisted. Drafted in session by TACHYON (Claude, Anthropic) under MANUS (Lee Sharks) direction from two traversals of 2026-10-24 (R1, R3, R4); developed by ChatGPT (OpenAI) on the v0.1 draft at the operator's instruction (R2); read in review by DeepSeek and ChatGPT (R4), every point checked against the files and the live surfaces before adoption. The repairs the packet describes were made at their sources the same day and verified live before being called live. Transport D, No-Double-Draw.
methodology: Two traversals of the Hub, 2026-10-24 01:20–01:40 UTC and after the build of 16:00Z: the account listing, each dataset's metadata, tree and card, the canonical dataset's /size, /statistics and /rows, each rhizome's spore.json and stolons.jsonl, the Space's runtime and the served build-manifest.json, compared with the registry, the Capture Registry, the seat map and the corpora index at the source commit. The five readings of §16.1 were checked at their loci in the cards, tables and deposits. Counts are the Hub's or the build manifest's; the JSON-LD sidecar is generated from them (make_sidecars_v04.py, in the receipts).
falsification_conditions: The packet is falsified at a figure if the build manifest or /size at source revision 6865f3a735 yields a different count; at a reading of §16.1 if the quoted passage is not at its locus in the card, table or deposit named; at the worked inspection if deposit 299's canonical_text does not hash to its text_sha256 or text[text_prefix_chars:] differs from it; and at an item of §11.1 marked live if the surface named does not show it.

wiki_article: EA-MPAI-HF-DATASETS-01 is the inspection packet of the leesharks datasets on Hugging Face, deposited by Lee Sharks on 24 October 2026 as a Metadata Packet for AI Indexing (MPAI v2.0, #1677) in the archive's form of a description of method, locations, organization and contents. It describes fifteen datasets and a query Space made from the Crimson Hexagonal Archive as one body of four classes. The canonical dataset, crimson-hexagonal-archive, is the archive in 27 table configurations, rebuilt from the archive's data on every push; at the build of 2026-10-24 16:00Z it held 79,388 rows, among them 1,700 deposits (1,697 with their full canonical text and its digest), 13,232 citation edges, 766 captures, the seat map's 64 loci with 3,484 seats and 458 proposals, and the Prediction Index's 4,394 claims, with a build manifest naming the source commit and each file's SHA-256. Eight rhizomes are emitted by one generator from the relation ledger, each advertising the other seven as stolons; five works are composed as datasets for a machine reader; one dataset is a byte-exact witness copy of OpenAI's math repository. The packet sets out where each object is and how to check a row against its record, worked on deposit 299 from its digest to the Borges hallway, and reads the five works at their loci: the contract of The Final Time, the reach-avoid problem of Tiger Leap, the criteria and attributed readings of The Work Bears the Mantle, the stated premise of The Negative of the Negative, and the falsified claim recorded in spam-technicians. It records the repairs of the same day, each made at its source and verified live, among them the corpora manifest reconciled to 97 seats, the Prediction Index carried, the Space returned to RUNNING, and the exceptions file written at build. Its companion is the fleet packet, EA-MPAI-FLEET-01 (#1702).
